nodes.label: @openmap/api
nodes.rationale: NestJS 11 on Fastify 5 with Mercurius serving the frozen schema-first GraphQL contract against Postgres (Prisma) and Memgraph (@openmap/graph); REQ-CORE-012. Config only from @openmap/config loadEnv().

nodes.label: API auth model (Keycloak JWT)
nodes.rationale: Every request carries a Keycloak-issued RS256 JWT verified with jose against the realm JWKS; issuer and client (azp/aud) checked; there is deliberately no auth-disabled mode, tests override the JWKS provider instead.

nodes.label: TenantContext
nodes.rationale: Request-scoped provider holding tenantId resolved from the token's tenant claim; every repository method takes tenantId first so no query can cross tenants.

nodes.label: Realm role hierarchy
nodes.rationale: openmap-admin ⊇ openmap-operator ⊇ openmap-analyst, openmap-auditor ⊇ openmap-analyst; mutations annotated with @Roles: CMDB/plan/asset/incident/scenario/discovery writes need operator, integration config needs admin, setLayerVisibility and askAssistant need analyst.

nodes.label: OutboxService.transaction
nodes.rationale: Business rows and outbox_events rows are written in the same Postgres transaction so a committed write always has its events and a rolled-back write leaves none; the API never writes to Memgraph, ClickHouse or Meilisearch directly, the reconciler drains and fans out.

nodes.label: CloudEvents 1.0 outbox envelope
nodes.rationale: Carries tenantid extension and traceparent from the active span; pending lists stores still to acknowledge (memgraph, clickhouse, meilisearch, websocket, bsm).

nodes.label: In-process EventBus and subscriptions
nodes.rationale: After commit envelopes are published on the EventBus; the subscriptions module forwards them to Mercurius pub/sub topics events, serviceHealthChanged, sweepProgress, scoped by tenant; connection_init must carry a valid token.

nodes.label: /healthz and /readyz probes
nodes.rationale: Readiness runs Postgres SELECT 1 and Memgraph RETURN 1 and returns 503 when either fails; intentionally unauthenticated along with the metrics route.

nodes.label: API Prometheus metrics
nodes.rationale: Served at METRICS_PATH: Node defaults, openmap_graphql_requests_total{operation,status}, openmap_graphql_duration_seconds.

nodes.label: runDiscovery mutation
nodes.rationale: Plans one scope per subnet CI (cidr, credentialRef, credentialType, exclusions) through @openmap/scheduler's planner and persists CollectorJobs as discovery_jobs.

nodes.label: OpenBao KV v2 credential resolution
nodes.rationale: Integration credentials are fetched at call time from ${OPENBAO_ADDR}/v1/${OPENBAO_MOUNT}/data/<credentialRef>; outbound calls additionally require FEATURE_OUTBOUND_INTEGRATIONS, a non-airgap profile and the tenant's outboundIntegrationsEnabled setting.

nodes.label: Business-service CI attributes and SLA
nodes.rationale: tier, usersAffected, revenuePerHour, slaTargetPercent etc. live on the CI; redundancy groups derive from part_of_service members grouped by redundancyGroup; SLA downtime is computed from openmap.bsm.health.changed events over a rolling 30-day window; health itself is read from Memgraph nodes in one batched query.

nodes.label: IPAM and DCIM graph conventions
nodes.rationale: Subnet CIs carry cidr and vrf; tree is CIDR containment within a VRF; ip_address CIs link via in_subnet; devices link to racks by located_in/mounted_on with startUnit/heightUnits/face; power feeds by powered_by with ratedWatts/currentWatts.

edges.source_location: After commit the envelopes are published on the in-process EventBus
The reconciler drains the outbox and fans out
outbound calls require FEATURE_OUTBOUND_INTEGRATIONS, a non-airgap profile
Health lives on graph nodes (set by the BSM engine)
located_in / powered_by edges reused by rack and power scenarios
There is no 'auth disabled' mode anywhere in the code
